map.以整年数加剩余月判断：剩余月数 ≥6 按 +1 年，满 6 个月以下按 +0.5: Judged by whole years plus remaining months: if remaining months >=6 count +1 year, otherwise a full 6 months or less counts +0.5 year (you can disable the "less than 6 months counts as half a month" option to use +1 year). Example: 3 years 8 months → N=4.
map.依据《劳动合同法》第 47 条，劳动者月工资高于本地区上年度职工月平均工资三倍的: Under Article 47 of the Labour Contract Law, where a worker's monthly wage exceeds three times the local prior-year average monthly wage, compensation is paid at three times that amount and the payment period is capped at twelve years. High earners are capped on both monthly wage and years.
map.依据《劳动合同法》计算解除/终止劳动合同的经济补偿金（N、N+1），支持月工资封: Calculates economic compensation for terminating a labour contract (N and N+1) under the Labour Contract Law, supporting the monthly wage cap and individual income tax estimate.
map.协商解除场景：员工 2019-01-15 入职、2022-09-10 离职，工作: Negotiated termination case: employee joined 2019-01-15 and left 2022-09-10, worked 3 years 8 months, average monthly salary over the last 12 months before leaving was 15,000 CNY, and three times the local prior-year average monthly wage is 30,000 CNY (not capped). Years of service N=4, so N+1 compensation = 5×15000 = 75000 CNY, which is below the tax-free allowance and received in full.
map.工作年限“六个月以上不满一年按一年计算”如何把握？: How to read "six months or more but less than one year counts as one year"?
map.月工资封顶后年限为何最高 12 年？: Why is the period capped at 12 years after the monthly wage cap?
map.算例：3 年 8 个月协商解除: Worked example: 3 years 8 months, negotiated termination
map.违法解除 2N 场景：同上高收入员工，用人单位违法解除按经济补偿标准二倍赔偿，2: Illegal termination 2N case: the same high-earner employee, where the employer terminates illegally and pays twice the economic compensation standard, 2N = 2×12×30000 = 720,000 CNY, with estimated tax about 58,080 CNY and about 661,920 CNY after tax.
map.高收入封顶场景：员工工作 12 年 1 个月、月薪 50000 元、当地 3 倍: High-earner cap case: employee with 12 years 1 month of service, monthly salary 50,000 CNY, and a local three-times cap of 30,000 CNY. The monthly wage above three times is taken as 30,000 and the period is capped at 12 years, so N=12 and N+1 compensation = 13×30000 = 390,000 CNY, of which the 30,000 CNY above the tax-free allowance gives about 900 CNY of tax.
map.：取入职 2019-01-15、离职 2022-09-10，总月数 = (202: : taking joining 2019-01-15 and leaving 2022-09-10, total months = (2022−2019)×12 + (9−1) = 44 months; the leaving day (10) is before the joining day (15) so no extra month is added, giving 3 whole years plus 8 remaining months (>=6 months counts as 1 year), so N=4. The 15,000 CNY monthly wage is below the 3x cap, so monthly wage = 15,000 CNY and N+1 compensation = 4×15000 + 15000 = 75,000 CNY; the tax-free allowance = (30000÷3×12)×3 = 360,000 CNY, and 75,000 CNY is within it, so no tax is due and 75,000 CNY is received in full.
